{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Compute the mean body mass in grams

print(f"Number of non-missing body_mass_g values: {len(df_clean)}")
print(f"Mean body mass (grams): {mean_body_mass}")"}
